changelog: **The browser gets only the dictionary namespaces a page uses (#3217, #2987):** the root layout used to ship the whole client dictionary (~430 KB of JSON per locale, 265 namespaces) on every page. It now ships the 19 shell namespaces, and every top-level directory of `src/app` mounts `<I18nScope scope="…">` (`src/i18n/scope.tsx`) in its layout to add the ones its own client components reach. The sets are computed by `scripts/i18n-scopes.mjs` (an over-inclusive scan of the client module graph) into `src/i18n/scopes.generated.ts`, regenerated by `npm run build` / `npm run dev`; `npm run check:i18n-scopes` (CI) fails on a stale manifest or an unmounted scope. A namespace that is somehow missing renders empty and logs `[i18n] namespace … was not shipped` instead of crashing. Dev-mode sizes: `/features` 965 → 528 KB (gzip 279 → 145 KB), `/auth/signin` 552 → 139 KB (gzip 166 → 40 KB).

en: Pages load faster: each page now downloads only the translations it uses.
tr: Sayfalar daha hızlı açılıyor: her sayfa artık yalnızca kullandığı çevirileri indiriyor.
de: Seiten laden schneller: Jede Seite lädt jetzt nur die Übersetzungen, die sie braucht.
